6ed84800bf3835c9d6a4e0c680086ccf9fef9a0b.ja:
## c3801 収支の恒等式と版間
- 差引=歳入−歳出、実質収支=差引−翌年度に繰り越すべき財源、実質単年度収支=単年度収支+積立金+繰上償還金−積立金取崩し額（当年度・前年度の両欄）、単年度収支=実質収支の差、歳入の状況の合計=歳入総額、版間（令和6年度カードの前年度欄=令和5年度カードの当年度欄）。式 1,222、不一致 1。
- 令和5年度 沖縄県：単年度収支 −1,179,138千円。実質収支（令和5年度 4,438,368、令和4年度 5,617,504）の差は −1,179,136千円（差 2千円）。令和4年度カードの令和4年度の実質収支も 5,617,504、令和6年度カードの前年度欄の単年度収支も −1,179,138。千円未満の四捨五入で生じる差は 1千円まで → KC-A1
6ed84800bf3835c9d6a4e0c680086ccf9fef9a0b.en:
## c3801 Balance identities and between editions
- Balance = revenue − expenditure; real balance = balance − revenue sources to be carried over to the next fiscal year; real single-year balance = single-year balance + reserve fund contributions + early redemptions − reserve fund withdrawals (both the current-year and previous-year columns); single-year balance = difference in real balance; total of the revenue status = total revenue; between editions (previous-year column of the FY2024 card = current-year column of the FY2023 card). 1,222 equations, 1 mismatch.
- FY2023 Okinawa Prefecture: single-year balance −1,179,138 thousand yen. The difference in real balance (FY2023 4,438,368, FY2022 5,617,504) is −1,179,136 thousand yen (a difference of 2 thousand yen). The FY2022 real balance on the FY2022 card is also 5,617,504, and the single-year balance in the previous-year column of the FY2024 card is also −1,179,138. A difference arising from rounding below one thousand yen is at most 1 thousand yen → KC-A1
